title: A Posteriori Error Estimation for Parabolic Equations with Enriched Galerkin Finite Element Methods
summary: This paper introduces a novel a posteriori error estimation framework for the enriched Galerkin (EG) finite element method applied to linear parabolic equations. While the EG method has been recognized for its local conservation property and computational efficiency compared to discontinuous Galerkin methods, its mathematical analysis in the context of a posteriori error estimation for parabolic problems remains unexplored.
